# dsh-mail
Mail in the DSH sidebar and mail tools for your agents: IMAP, POP3, SMTP and OAuth2 accounts.

Mail for agents and humans in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Connect any IMAP or
POP3 mailbox, Gmail or

Microsoft 365 / Outlook.com (OAuth2 with your own
client, or a Gmail app password), a Tzekos Mail w

ebmail, or a sending
service (Lettermint, Resend, AgentMail). Read your mail in the sidebar Mail
tab

, and let agents read, search, file and send mail through the `mail_*`
tools, with sends drafted fir

ts read, search, file and send mail through the `mail_*`
tools, with sends drafted first by default.

Everything runs on your DSH host: mail is fetched straight from your own
servers into a local cache,

nothing is sent anywhere else, and there is no
telemetry.
## What is in version 0.2 (phases 1 to 4 of v2)

- **Accounts** in DSH Settings: a "Mail" settings section (and the gear in the
tab) to add, edit, te

st and remove accounts. Several accounts at once.
- **Account types**: generic IMAP + SMTP, POP3 + S

MTP, Google (app password
or OAuth2), Microsoft 365 / Outlook.com (OAuth2), self-hosted (IMAP or POP

3), Tzekos Mail (webmail agent API, optional),
Lettermint and Resend (send only), AgentMail.
- **Loc

al cache** (built-in `node:sqlite`): folders, messages, threads and
flags; initial sync of the last

90 days (newest 1000 per folder), then
incremental by UID; background polling of every Inbox; retent

ion setting.
- **Mail tab**: account switcher with "All inboxes", folder list with unread
counts, th

read list (unread dot, avatar, sender, time, subject, snippet,
flag / attachment / count badges), se

arch with `from:` `subject:`
`is:unread` `has:attachment` `after:` `before:`, filter chips, quick ac

tions
(archive, delete, read / unread, flag), multi-select, reading view with
sanitised HTML in a sa

ndboxed frame, "Load images" on request, attachment
downloads, a simple composer with reply and forw

ard, and the review queue
with agent drafts. Keyboard: j / k, Enter, e, #, r, c, /.
- **Agent tools*

*: every v0.1 tool keeps its name and arguments; new tools
`mail_accounts`, `mail_folders`, `mail_se

arch`, `mail_mark`, `mail_move`,
`mail_draft`, `mail_attachments`, `mail_doctor`.

- **Google and Microsoft with OAuth2** (phase 2): bring your own OAuth client,
authorization code +

PKCE, XOAUTH2 for IMAP and SMTP, tokens encrypted at
rest, automatic refresh, a Reconnect banner, th

e Microsoft device code
sign-in, and Microsoft Graph sendMail when a tenant disabled SMTP AUTH.

providers (European first,

each checked by a probe script), Twilio SendGrid
(send, optional Inbound Parse webhook), mass-send

hardening
(List-Unsubscribe with One-Click, suppression list, per-account rate limits,
jitter, a cir

cuit breaker, dry run), a first-contact check for agents, a
local audit log, `mail_forward`, and an

## Accounts

Open **Settings, Mail** (or the gear in the Mail tab), pick a type and fill in
the form. **Test conn

ection** logs in (IMAP LIST, POP3 STAT, SMTP verify or an
API call) and reports each step; it never

## Security

- Every route sits behind four layers: loopback peer, trusted Host (plus
`trustedHosts`), a short-li

ved capability token for mutations, and the DSH
browser-session cookie.
- No read response ever cont

ains a secret; provider errors are scrubbed.
- HTML mail is sanitised on the host (no scripts, forms

, frames or event
handlers, remote images blocked until you ask) and shown in a sandboxed
frame with

out script permission under a strict Content Security Policy.
Relative links are removed (they would

point at the DSH origin).
- Server-side first: the browser talks only to the DSH host. Every provid

er
connection (IMAP, POP3, SMTP, the HTTP APIs, OAuth token exchange and
refresh) is made by the ser

ver. In a rendered mail nothing points the
browser at another host:
- remote images, CSS background

images, `@import` and fonts are blocked by
default (the count is shown). "Load images" rewrites imag

es to a signed
same-origin proxy (`GET /dsh-mail/api/img`): the server fetches them with
no cookies,

no Referer and a generic User-Agent, public addresses only
(the DNS answer is checked and pinned fo

r the connection, redirects are
re-checked at every hop, at most 3), ports 80/443/8080/8443, raster

images
only (magic bytes checked, no SVG), 5 MB and 10 s caps. The frame's CSP
allows images only fr

om `data:`, `cid:` and the DSH origin.
- `http://` image URLs are upgraded to https. Plain http is u

sed only when
`render.allowHttpImages` is on (default off); otherwise such an image
stays blocked. T

here is no silent plaintext fallback.
- links point at a signed page on the DSH origin (`GET /dsh-ma

il/api/link`)
that shows the real destination and opens it with
`rel="noopener noreferrer"` (no Refe

rer, no opener).
- DNS prefetch is off in the frame. Avatars are initials (no Gravatar).
- Attachmen

rmint, Resend, AgentMail, SendGrid, Tzekos Mail)
must be https, or plain http to a loopback host, an
